product_one_liner.value: Hover turns smartphone photos of homes and buildings into interactive 3D models so construction professionals, insurance experts, and homeowners can measure, design, and scope projects.

pricing_page.notes: Hover has a public pricing page with plan information, including a $2,999/year plan.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in Hover customer stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists Hover’s company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company profile lists its HQ as San Francisco, California, USA.

founded_year.notes: Hover’s LinkedIn company profile says it was founded in 2011.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is organized around construction, homeowners, insurance, case studies, news and product updates; the visible recent posts are explanatory/product-oriented rather than engineer-authored articles about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Hover has a public API developer portal with multiple guides and reference articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is titled Principal Agentic AI Engineer.

model_provider.notes: Hover’s public GenAI notice describes custom generative AI combined with publicly accessible pretrained generative AI technologies but does not name a model or provider; the Trust Center lists an AI Practices FAQ and subprocessors resource as access-request materials.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names SOC 2 Type II.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists a completed $3.6 million Debt - General deal dated February 19, 2026 as Hover’s latest deal.

raised_18mo.notes: PitchBook lists a $3.6 million debt financing dated February 19, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Hover has a live Sales Development Representative (SDR) posting.

launched_6mo.notes: The dated July 24, 2026 Enhance feature article describes turning a 3D project scope into photorealistic designs; this falls within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: LinkedIn profile information lists Tali Leff as VP, Marketing at Hover from April 1, 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Hover’s help center documents its Zoho CRM integration.
